source.source_of_values: Oppel et al., Journal of Avian Biology (2025), published Results: Transferring models to populations in Germany

interpretation.reference: Retrospective majority-class accuracy computed from published German labels: post-hoc oracle, NOT a deployable training-only comparator
interpretation.home_and_nest: The 99-season published totals allow descriptive contrasts, not individual probability/log-score gain or independent inference
interpretation.success: 55 successes among 89 published attempts; exact denominator of the model's reported 84.7% success accuracy has not been reconciled to source-level eligible examples; gap is illustrative, not paired
interpretation.biological_replication_unit: bird_id, not individual seasons, GPS rows or transmitters; repeated years for a bird stay in one partition
interpretation.scientific_claim_limit: No new German external validation, probability model or ODSP group-level gain follows from this audit

future_analysis_prerequisites: Verify canonical animal and two-population rosters without reading individual outcome rows
Freeze one binary target and its conditional sample before examining source responses
Freeze fitted model/reference provenance and disjoint adaptation/calibration/validation bird roles
Score each held-out bird once with individual-mean log-score gain, and check target exchangeability
Treat previously published German model outcomes as postpublication comparison, never undiscovered biology
